must_fix.title: Exhaustive match arms in display_label() and sort_order()
must_fix.description: Both display_label() and sort_order() use exhaustive match on DocSubtype. Adding StageReview will cause compile errors if not updated simultaneously.
must_fix.suggestion: Add StageReview arm to display_label() (returning 'レビュー') and sort_order() (subtype_order 6). Must be in same commit as enum addition.

must_fix.title: Exhaustive match in DocSubtype::as_str()
must_fix.description: DocSubtype::as_str() is an exhaustive match. Adding StageReview without a corresponding arm will cause a compile error.

must_fix.title: Metadata deserialization must handle new subtype string
must_fix.description: find_documents_by_issue() in symbol_store.rs uses exhaustive match on doc_subtype strings. Missing 'stage_review' arm returns error.

should_fix.title: Verify regex against actual file paths
should_fix.description: The regex extracts issue number from filename (new convention vs directory-based extraction in existing patterns).
should_fix.suggestion: Add 2-3 test cases with edge cases (multi-digit issue numbers, long descriptions with hyphens).

should_fix.title: IssueDocumentsResult::grouped() category list
should_fix.description: grouped() hardcodes categories. If StageReview maps to 'レビュー', no change needed. If distinct label used, must be added.
should_fix.suggestion: Use 'レビュー' for StageReview display_label to match existing review categories.

should_fix.title: test_scan_dev_reports_with_temp_dir assertion count
should_fix.description: Test asserts exactly 3 entries. Adding review files to fixture requires updating to 4.
should_fix.suggestion: Update existing test assertion or create separate test.

should_fix.title: test_doc_subtype_as_str needs new variant
should_fix.description: Test explicitly checks all as_str() values. New variant needs assertion.

nice_to_have.title: Regex compilation on every call
nice_to_have.description: build_pattern_rules() recompiles all regex patterns each call. Pre-existing concern.
nice_to_have.suggestion: Consider LazyLock for pattern compilation. Not blocking for this issue.

nice_to_have.title: KnowledgeRelation variant consideration
nice_to_have.description: Using HasReview is consistent with existing review types.
nice_to_have.suggestion: Using HasReview is fine. Document if different relation was considered.

nice_to_have.title: Greedy .* in regex could match unexpected filenames
nice_to_have.description: Pattern .*\.md$ is greedy. Unlikely issue with anchored prefix but could be defensive.

summary: Low-risk, well-scoped change. Primary impact: new DocSubtype::StageReview variant requiring updates to 3 exhaustive match blocks and 1 deserialization match. All will produce compile errors if missed. No new dependencies. Minor test updates needed.
